summary: Flame Shock + Lava Burst caster spec. Lava Burst is a guaranteed critical strike against a target with Flame Shock applied, so the rotation is built around keeping Flame Shock active.

mechanicalChanges.change: Lightning Bolt / Chain Lightning cast time reduced
mechanicalChanges.detail: Ranks 4-10 of Lightning Bolt cast in 2.5 sec (down from Classic's 3 sec); Chain Lightning rank 1 is a 2 sec cast with a 6 sec cooldown.

mechanicalChanges.change: Fire Nova is now a spell, not a totem
mechanicalChanges.detail: 30 yd range, instant cast, 10 sec cooldown; blasts everything within 10 yd of your Fire totem.
New utility: relocate your totems up to 30 yd away, or recall them instantly.

statPriority.rationale: Spell Power improves direct casts, while Intellect funds your opener and enough mana to heal yourself. Nothing in the beta client contradicts Classic's caster stat behavior.

alsoReported.note: Icy Veins-style sources weight Hit/Haste higher for raid-pace content; treat as a later-game variant once gear/hit caps matter more than they do at level 30.

level30: Start from range with Lightning Bolt and place Earthbind where it creates another cast window.
Use Flame Shock and Searing Totem on a target that will live long enough for repeated damage.
Use Earth Shock for interrupt or direct hit, and Frost Shock on a moving target when slow matters.
Continue Lightning Bolt on single target; use Fire Nova for packs.
level60: Flame Shock first, and refresh before it drops (Lava Burst deals 20% more to a target with Flame Shock up).
Lava Burst on cooldown as your hardest hitting spell.
Lightning Bolt as filler between Flame Shock/Lava Burst (Lightning Overload can trigger a free extra bolt).

gearingNotes.note: Consumables: Minor Arcane Elixir (+5 spell damage), Lesser Spellblasting Potion (+11 spell damage).
Enchants: Minor Wizard Oil (+8 spell damage/healing), Enchant Bracer - Minor Intellect (+3 Intellect).

keyTalents: Lava Burst (7/2 capstone) — guaranteed crit vs. Flame Shock target
Elemental Devastation — offensive spell crits refresh your melee/ranged crit chance
Lightning Overload — chance for a free second Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning
Call of Flame — buffs Fire totems, Flame Shock, Fire Nova and Searing Totem damage
Elemental Alacrity — reduces cast time of Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Burst

recommendedBuild.note: Alternative at 30: Earthbound instead of Lightning Overload's first point, for an instant root when soloing. Dipping into Restoration for Mindfulness + Mana Tide Totem is reported as strong for sustain in long fights — note Mana Tide sits on row 4 in Forever (needs 15 Restoration points), so that dip is a level-60 option, not a level-30 one.

caveat: Forever beta, level cap 30 as of 2026-10. Most rotation/stat-priority claims are explicitly labeled 'classic-assumed' by their own source (classicwowforever.com) — meaning nothing in the beta client contradicts Classic Era behavior, not that it's been confirmed. Treat as a strong starting point, not settled fact.
